rv.q: While The Village Theater Group’s revival of the oft seen The Price does not do full justice to the play, it ultimately still has has a powerful impact...
Director Noelle McGrath’s tightly crafted staging for the Village Theater Group’s inaugural production amplifies this intensity and the long-term impact of the Great Depression on its characters.

cn.t: Miller's exploration of moral ambiguity and Depression-era consequences resonates in this tightly crafted Off-Broadway revival, with critics praising the production's intensity and complex character layers.
